g.text: # two rooms + a corridor, columns turned 45° — built from commands

text.tspan: uedcli actor show Room_8aayzq | uedcli brush clip - --plane 160,320,160 1,1,0 --keep below \
uedcli actor show Room_8aayzq | uedcli brush clip - --plane -160,320,160 -1,1,0 --keep below \
uedcli actor show Room_8aayzq | uedcli brush clip - --plane 160,-320,160 1,-1,0 --keep below \
uedcli actor show Room_8aayzq | uedcli brush clip - --plane -160,-320,160 -1,-1,0 --keep below \
uedcli actor prop set Col_evceh1 Rotation.Yaw=8192
uedcli actor prop set Col_2hkpf5 Rotation.Yaw=8192
